matches.preview: Oracle90's model strongly favours Arsenal, giving them an 81% probability of victory compared to 13% for a draw and 6% for a Coventry City win. The home side ended last season with five straight Premier League wins, keeping clean sheets in four of those matches. Coventry City return to this level, with their six-match unbeaten run at the end of last season now part of their lower-tier history, while the two clubs have no recorded head-to-head fixtures. The model leans towards a higher-scoring outcome, rating the chance of over 2.5 total goals at 60%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 的模型高度看好 Arsenal，預測其勝率為 81%，和局機率為 13%，而 Coventry City 獲勝的機率則為 6%。主隊在上賽季結束時取得英超五連勝，其中四場比賽保持零封。Coventry City 重返此層級賽事，他們在上賽季末段的六場不敗紀錄已成為低層級聯賽歷史的一部分，而兩家俱樂部之間此前並沒有交手紀錄。模型傾向於出現較多進球的結果，評估總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率為 60%。

matches.preview: The Oracle90 model strongly favours an away victory, giving Manchester United a 66% chance of winning, while Hull City stand at 13% and the draw is 21%. Manchester United concluded their previous top-flight campaign with five wins from their final six matches, including a 3-0 victory at Brighton. Hull City return to this level after ending last season in the second tier with a 2-1 win against Norwich. History points the same way, as Manchester United went unbeaten in their five meetings between 2014 and 2017. The model leans towards a higher-scoring contest, giving over 2.5 goals a 56% probability.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 模型高度看好客隊獲勝，給予 Manchester United 66% 的勝率，Hull City 的勝率為 13%，和局機率則是 21%。Manchester United 在上個頂級聯賽賽季的最後六場比賽中取得五勝，其中包括客場以 3-0 戰勝 Brighton。Hull City 在上個賽季以 2-1 擊敗 Norwich 結束次級聯賽賽程後，重新回到這個層級。對戰歷史也呈現相同趨勢，Manchester United 在 2014 年至 2017 年間的五次交手中保持不敗。模型傾向認為這將是一場進球較多的對決，總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率為 56%。

matches.preview: Oracle90’s model gives Everton a moderate advantage at 44%, with a draw and a Crystal Palace win both rated at 28%. Neither side ended the previous campaign strongly, as both teams failed to win any of their final six matches in May. However, Everton hold a strong recent record in this fixture, remaining unbeaten across the last five meetings with three victories and two draws. That includes a 2-2 draw when the pair met in May. The model leans slightly towards a lower-scoring contest for this fixture, placing under 2.5 goals at a 52% probability.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 的模型給予 Everton 44% 的適度優勢，和局與 Crystal Palace 勝出的機率皆為 28%。兩隊在上個賽季尾聲的表現都不算強勢，雙方在五月的最後六場賽事中均未能獲勝。然而，Everton 近期在此對戰中擁有優異的紀錄，在最近五次交手中取得三勝二和保持不敗，其中包括兩隊於五月交手時以 2-2 戰平。針對本場賽事，模型稍微偏向總進球數較低的對局，總進球數少於 2.5 球的機率為 52%。

matches.preview: The model considers this fixture finely balanced, giving Sunderland a 36% chance of victory against 36% for Ipswich Town, with the draw rated at 28%. Ipswich completed their second-tier campaign at the end of last season on a five-match unbeaten streak, culminating in a 3-0 home victory. Meanwhile, Sunderland finished their top-flight term strongly, collecting eight points from their final four games and winning their last two. Historical head-to-head records favour the hosts, as Ipswich won all four previous meetings between 2017 and 2024. Finally, the data suggests a close contest, leaning slightly towards under 2.5 total goals at 52%.
matches.preview_zh: 預測模型認為這場對決相當均勢，Sunderland 的勝率為 36%，Ipswich Town 為 36%，和局機率則為 28%。Ipswich 上賽季末在次級聯賽以連續五場不敗劃下句點，最後一場更是在主場以 3 比 0 獲勝。與此同時，Sunderland 在頂級聯賽尾聲表現強勁，最後四場比賽一共拿下八分，且最後兩場皆取得勝利。歷史對戰紀錄則偏向主隊，Ipswich 在 2017 年至 2024 年間的四次對決中取得全勝。最後，數據顯示這將是一場勢均力敵的較量，總進球數少於 2.5 球的機率略高，為 52%。

matches.preview: The model gives Nottingham Forest a moderate advantage in this fixture, rating a home victory at 42% compared to 30% for Leeds United and 28% for a draw. Forest ended last season winless in their final three matches, including consecutive 1-1 draws at home. Head-to-head records from the previous campaign were evenly split, with both sides trading 3-1 home wins. Leeds themselves struggled on the road towards the end of the term, failing to win any of their last three away fixtures. For total goals, the forecast leans marginally towards a lower-scoring match, placing a 51% probability on under 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: 模型顯示 Nottingham Forest 在本場對決中佔有些微優勢，預測主隊獲勝機率為 42%，相比之下 Leeds United 為 30%，和局則為 28%。Forest 上賽季在最後三場比賽中均未嘗勝績，其中包括主場連續兩場 1-1 踢平。上一季雙方的對戰紀錄平分秋色，兩隊各自在主場以 3-1 獲勝。Leeds 本身在季末的客場表現同樣陷入苦戰，最後三場客場賽事皆未能取勝。在總進球數方面，預測略微偏向進球數較少的比賽，顯示總進球數低於 2.5 球的機率為 51%。

matches.preview: The Oracle90 model gives Brentford a moderate advantage at home, assigning them a 40% chance of victory compared to 34% for Tottenham Hotspur and 26% for the draw. Despite Brentford holding the edge in the probabilities, recent head-to-head history favours the visitors, who are unbeaten in their last five meetings with Brentford, keeping clean sheets in three of them. Brentford concluded their previous campaign with mixed home results, including a 3-0 win against West Ham and a 2-2 draw with Crystal Palace. The model leans towards a higher-scoring fixture, evaluating the probability of over 2.5 total goals at 58%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 模型認為 Brentford 在主場佔據適度優勢，評估他們的勝率為 40%，相比之下 Tottenham Hotspur 的勝率為 34%，和局機率則為 26%。儘管 Brentford 在機率上佔優，但近期的對賽歷史較有利於客隊，Tottenham Hotspur 在近五次與 Brentford 交手中保持不敗，其中更有三場零封對手。Brentford 在上個賽季結束前的主場戰績好壞參半，包括以 3 比 0 戰勝 West Ham，以及以 2 比 2 踢平 Crystal Palace。模型傾向認為本場比賽會有較多進球，評估總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率為 58%。

matches.preview: The model gives Brighton and Hove Albion a slight edge at 43%, with an Aston Villa win calculated at 31% and the draw at 26%. Villa hold the upper hand in recent head-to-head matches. They have won the last three meetings between the sides, including a 4-3 victory on this ground in December 2025. Villa also finished the previous league campaign strongly with back-to-back wins against Liverpool and Manchester City, whereas Brighton lost their final two fixtures without scoring. The statistical model leans towards a high-scoring encounter, placing a 58% probability on over 2.5 total goals.
matches.preview_zh: 數據模型顯示 Brighton and Hove Albion 稍微占優，勝率為 43%，Aston Villa 獲勝的機率計算為 31%，和局則為 26%。Villa 在近期對戰紀錄中占據上風。他們在兩隊最近三次交手中取得全勝，其中包括 2025 年 12 月在這座球場以 4 比 3 獲勝。Villa 在上個聯賽賽季尾聲表現強勁，接連擊敗 Liverpool 與 Manchester City，而 Brighton 則在最後兩場賽事皆未能進球且吞下敗仗。統計模型傾向這將是一場高比分的對決，估計總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率為 58%。

matches.preview: Oracle90’s model strongly favours Manchester City, assigning the hosts a 65% probability of victory, while a draw stands at 20% and a Bournemouth win at 15%. City posted consecutive 3-0 home victories over Brentford and Crystal Palace late last season, though Bournemouth ended their campaign undefeated in six matches. That run included a 1-1 draw between these sides in May. However, Manchester City earned 3-1 victories in both of their home meetings against Bournemouth during 2025. The statistical model expects an open encounter, giving a 66% probability to over 2.5 total goals.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 的數據模型高度看好 Manchester City，預估主隊獲勝機率為 65%，和局機率為 20%，而 Bournemouth 勝出機率則為 15%。Manchester City 在上季尾聲曾於主場連續以 3-0 擊敗 Brentford 與 Crystal Palace，不過 Bournemouth 當時也以連續六場不敗結束了他們的賽季。這波不敗戰績包含了兩隊在五月交手時以 1-1 戰平的比賽。然而，Manchester City 在 2025 年兩次於主場對陣 Bournemouth 的比賽中，皆以 3-1 贏得勝利。統計模型預期本場交手場面將較為開放，總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率為 66%。

matches.preview: Oracle90’s model gives Liverpool a 45% chance of victory away from home, while Newcastle United hold a 30% likelihood and the draw stands at 25%. Head-to-head records favour the visitors, who have won the last three encounters between the clubs, including a 4-1 win in January 2026. Newcastle ended last season with two victories from their final three home league matches. Conversely, Liverpool lost their last two away fixtures of the previous campaign, conceding seven goals across those trips. The projection leans towards a high-scoring match, rating the likelihood of over 2.5 total goals at 63%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 的模型預測 Liverpool 客場獲勝的機率為 45%，Newcastle United 獲勝機率為 30%，和局機率則為 25%。歷史對戰紀錄有利於客隊，他們在兩隊最近三次交手中全部獲勝，其中包括 2026 年 1 月以 4 比 1 獲勝的比賽。Newcastle 在上賽季最後三場聯賽主場賽事中取得兩勝。相對地，Liverpool 在上賽季最後兩場客場賽事皆吞下敗仗，這兩場比賽一共失了七球。預測結果偏向高比分的比賽，總進球數超過 2.5 球的機率為 63%。

matches.preview: The model gives Chelsea a slight edge with a 43% probability of taking victory, compared to 31% for a Fulham win and 26% for a draw. Fulham closed their previous fixtures with a 2-0 home win over Newcastle, though they won only twice in their last six matches. Chelsea struggled during the same period, suffering four defeats in six games, including a 2-1 loss at Sunderland. Head-to-head meetings have been closely fought, though Fulham won the most recent encounter 2-1 in January 2026. Statistical projections lean towards a higher-scoring match, assigning a 57% chance to over 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: 模型預測 Chelsea 稍微佔優，獲勝機率為 43%，相比之下 Fulham 勝率為 31%，和局機率則為 26%。Fulham 在上一場比賽以主場 2 比 0 擊敗 Newcastle，不過他們在最近六場比賽中僅取得兩勝。Chelsea 在同期同樣陷入掙扎，六場比賽中吞下四場敗仗，包括以 1 比 2 不敵 Sunderland。兩隊過往交手過程相當緊湊，不過 Fulham 在 2026 年 1 月最近一次交鋒中以 2 比 1 獲勝。統計推估傾向於這是一場比分較高的比賽，總進球數超過 2.5 個的機率為 57%。
